realized_dominance.functional: effect-support hurdle plus unweighted Pareto pairwise order over existing paired closed-loop score and hard-safety deltas
realized_dominance.question: Does operator-aligned structured outcome order close the deployment gap once the mediator state is actually sufficient?
realized_dominance.state: QPE+D plus exact V54 realized endpoint mediator

branch_order_policy: strict sequential fail-closed: predicted_dominance is not evaluated if realized_dominance fails
dominant_bottleneck: operator-aligned structured outcome order over an identified realized mediator, followed by t0 mediator distillation
internal_convergence_condition: A t0-deployable TRAIN arm passes the frozen nested identification and deployment gates. Freeze immediately; no further TRAIN algorithm tuning. Perform engineering-only runtime integration and untouched paired validation. If untouched passes independently, internal algorithm search stops and external baseline/official closed-loop benchmarking begins.
mechanism_hypothesis: V54 identifies the actual one-replan treatment-control ego transition, but binary beneficial/nonbeneficial ranking fails to preserve deployment severity and hard-tail order. If the realized endpoint is a sufficient mediator, an unweighted paired outcome dominance functional should close the historical paired deployment gate. Only after that diagnostic oracle passes may the mediator be distilled from the already-fixed V53 pre-execution planned operator profile and tested as a t0-available state.
name: Dynamic-Mediator Outcome Retention
